name: doc-rfc-review
description: Reviews an RFC or design doc against your PRD and returns review comments by severity, the edge cases and missing requirements, questions for the author, and a go, revise or discuss call for the named approver. Use for "run doc-rfc-review", "review this RFC", "review this design doc", "is this spec missing anything", "find the edge cases", "nobody will read this 30-page RFC", "comments on the tech design", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
